DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX) ; DECLARE @FirstOFMonth varchar(20); SET @FirstOFMonth = @EmailRecipients BEGIN SET @tableHTML = N'

Number of records loaded to the EPSDTWellServices table per Market

' + N'' + N'' + CAST(( SELECT DISTINCT td = APPLG.MNTH_YR, '', td = JB.[JobCode], '', td = CASE WHEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) = 'WN' AND SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],27,8) = '' THEN 'WNY' WHEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],26,8) = '' THEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) WHEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],27,8) != '' AND SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) = 'WN' THEN 'WNY' + ' ' + SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],27,8) WHEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],27,8) != '' AND SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) != 'WN' THEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) + ' ' + SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],26,8) END , '', td = APPLG.[LogDesc], '' FROM (SELECT AP.[AppLogId],AP.[Type],LogDate = cast (AP.[LogDateTime] as date),AP.[JobId],AP.[LogDesc], MNTH_YR =FORMAT([LogDateTime], 'yyyy-MM') FROM (SELECT AppLogID = MAX ([AppLogID]), JobID, LogDate = FORMAT([LogDateTime], 'yyyy-MM') FROM [EPSDT].[dbo].[EPSDTAppLog] WHERE Type = 'JobCount' And LogDesc like 'WellServices%' GROUP BY JobID, FORMAT([LogDateTime], 'yyyy-MM') ) A INNER JOIN [EPSDT].[dbo].[EPSDTAppLog] AP ON A.AppLogID = AP.AppLogID AND A.JobID = AP.JobId AND A.LogDate = FORMAT([LogDateTime], 'yyyy-MM'))APPLG LEFT JOIN [dbo].[EPSDTJob] JB ON APPLG.JobID = JB.JobID WHERE APPLG.LogDate >= @FirstOFMonth AND JobCode not in ('StateImportVAWellServices') Order by APPLG.MNTH_YR, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) = 'WN' AND SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],27,8) = '' THEN 'WNY' WHEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],26,8) = '' THEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) WHEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],27,8) != '' AND SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) = 'WN' THEN 'WNY' + ' ' + SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],27,8) WHEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],27,8) != '' AND SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) != 'WN' THEN SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],12,2) + ' ' + SUBSTRING (JB.[JobCode],26,8) END FOR XML PATH('tr'), TYPE) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'
RunDateJobCodeMarketFileTypeLogDesc
' END EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail @recipients=@FirstOFMonth , @subject = 'Number of records loaded to the EPSDTWellServices table per Market' , @body = @tableHTML , @body_format = 'HTML'
